page.meta_description: Ophelia is the court daughter Hamlet loved and then cast off; her mad songs and death by water are the play's second tragedy beside the prince's revenge.…
page.content:
Polonius's daughter whose songs and drowning follow Hamlet's rejection.

How Ophelia connects

  • Work: Hamlet — Ophelia is the court daughter whose death follows Hamlet's revenge plot.
  • Character: Hamlet (prince) — Hamlet's rejection of Ophelia precedes her madness and death.

What is Ophelia?

Ophelia is the court daughter Hamlet loved and then cast off; her mad songs and death by water are the play's second tragedy beside the prince's revenge.

Key threads lead to Hamlet and Hamlet (prince).
